notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide and docs/evidence/accountcard.md at 207d6e7. The guide's Sources note and the evidence were checked on 13 October 2026 on the 12 October build (mirror v0.1.78-c1fa197), so items citing them carry that build. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). Its AccountCard.tsx and the accountCard/* tokens still match every guide and evidence sentence used here, read from source, not run: state defaults to connected, title to “Personal account” and subtitle to “**** 5651”; the subtitle shows only on a connected tile and an empty one is hidden; the art is imageSource (a URL string becomes { uri }) at width 100% and aspectRatio imageRatio (default 125 / 82), with no radius, and with no imageSource an empty box; cardSlot replaces the art or the add field in either state and gets the tile's modes; the add field is #ede8ff with an 8 px radius and a centred ic_add plus whose icon modes start from AppearanceBrand Secondary, Emphasis Low, Button / Size M with the caller's modes on top; the root is width 100%, a column with an 8 px gap, and opacity 0.5 when disabled with or without onPress; without onPress it is a View named by accessibilityLabel or the title, with onPress a Pressable button that drops to 0.7 opacity while pressed and doesn't press when disabled; title and subtitle are cut to one line unless disableTruncation. The 14 accountCard/* tokens are single-mode literals, so modes change only the plus. No guide sentence is contradicted. Not recorded as a rule: the Sources sentence “The tile ignores the theme provider, so pass modes on it”, because the building rules keep Color Mode off components and the tile's text and field don't change with modes; the fact that it ignores JFSThemeProvider is kept on the modes fact. Not counted as gaps: the role-less preview root, the art img and plus svg not hidden from screen readers on the web, and Color Mode. The guide names no case to avoid the tile and no component to use instead, so avoidWhen is empty. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every tile), and the guide's Slot gap modes on its HStack and VStack are left out. Each tile gets Figma's 125 px through style width, the layout the Sizing section asks for (the guide wraps each tile in a 125 px VStack). The package ships no card art and the guide's photo is a docs asset, so examples pass the art the way the package's own JSDoc does, require('./card.png'), standing for the app's art. Left out of examples: the playground, the In context status line (plain page copy) and the three Don'ts.

examples.purpose: Linked accounts, the guide's In context: an Accounts title, then each linked account as a tile with the add tile last. Each onPress is the screen's own action (open the account, or start linking a new one). Each tile gets Figma's 125 px where it is placed; the app supplies the card art, since the package ships none.
examples.jsx:
<VStack>
  <Title title="Accounts" subtitle="Linked to JioFinance" />
  <HStack>
    <AccountCard
      title="Joint account"
      subtitle="**** 4821"
      imageSource={require('./card.png')}
      onPress={() => {}}
      style={{ width: 125 }}
    />
    <AccountCard
      state="add"
      title="Add account"
      onPress={() => {}}
      style={{ width: 125 }}
    />
  </HStack>
</VStack>

from.quote: The Accounts screen shows each linked account as a tile, with the add tile last.
